channel.title: LittlePrintQuests: Pretend Play Printables
channel.description: Pretend Play Printables from LittlePrintQuests, printable and personalized for kids.

item.title: Toddler Pretend Play Printable: Dino Dig Lab for Ages 2 to 4
item.description: A dino Dig Lab dramatic play kit made for little hands: big pictures, thick cut lines and picture order forms toddlers and preschoolers fill in by circling. Personalized with your child’s name.

item.title: Dino Dig Lab Pretend Play Printable Kit for Kids, Personalized
item.description: Turn the living room into your child’s own dino Dig Lab: shop signs, order forms, play money, props and a grown-up guide full of play ideas, all with their name on it. A screen-free dramatic play set to print at home.
